title.en: Printed-row question: When is Diesel 60 the off-grid pump to name
title.zh: 先看已印出的行：什么时候点名柴油60作为无电网泵

description.en: Taken from the printed row: When you need the printed 35 m³/h trailer and not the LZ-60 table. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132 at 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 350 m and 3500 kg for sites without stable grid power. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. LZ-60 prints the same code string at 50 m³/h, 100 m conveying and 300 m height. Read it in the Xingtai table. Off-grid does not allow you to mix those rows.
description.zh: 当你要的是已印的 35 m³/h 拖泵，而不是 LZ-60 那张表。河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油60 / HBT60-13.132 列为 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 350 m、3500 kg，用于电网不便的工地。LZ-60 用同一串代号印了 50 m³/h、输送 100 m、高度 300 m。没有电网也不能把两行混用。

h1.en: Printed-row question: When is Diesel 60 the off-grid pump to name
h1.zh: 先看已印出的行：什么时候点名柴油60作为无电网泵

directAnswer.en: Taken from the printed row: When you need the printed 35 m³/h trailer and not the LZ-60 table. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132 at 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 350 m and 3500 kg for sites without stable grid power. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. LZ-60 prints the same code string at 50 m³/h, 100 m conveying and 300 m height. Read it in the Xingtai table. Off-grid does not allow you to mix those rows.
directAnswer.zh: 当你要的是已印的 35 m³/h 拖泵，而不是 LZ-60 那张表。河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油60 / HBT60-13.132 列为 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 350 m、3500 kg，用于电网不便的工地。LZ-60 用同一串代号印了 50 m³/h、输送 100 m、高度 300 m。没有电网也不能把两行混用。

body.en: The reference page “Epoxy” uses “History” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. Taken from the printed row: When the comparison is 35 m³/h, 144 kW and 150 m / 350 m, and the site has no stable grid. Keep this cell as published. Off-grid does not allow you to mix those rows. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It prints 75 kW, 35 m³/h and three stone rows for building placement. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Taken from the printed row: LZ-60 prints 4 cm and below on its own page. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epoxy
body.zh: 来源页《Epoxy》用“沿革”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。目录里已经写着：对照的是 35 m³/h、144 kW 和 150 m / 350 m，且现场没有稳定电网时。不要在同一个代号下改用 LZ-60 的 50 m³/h 表。这一格照已印出的读：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epoxy

body.en: “Chemistry” is an outline label from “Epoxy”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Keep this cell as published. Do not use LZ-60’s 50 m³/h table under the same code string. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Diesel 50 is 30 m³/h and 150 m / 450 m. Read it in the Xingtai table. Same 35 m³/h does not make it a diesel pump. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Keep this cell as published. Diesel 60 prints 3500 kg.
body.zh: “化学关系”是《Epoxy》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。这一格照已印出的读：当你要的是已印的 35 m³/h 拖泵，而不是 LZ-60 那张表。邢台河北品锦机械把柴油60 / HBT60-13.132 列为 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 350 m、3500 kg，用于电网不便的工地。LZ-60 用同一串代号印了 50 m³/h、输送 100 m、高度 300 m。没有电网也不能把两行混用。旁边那一台不在这句话里。柴油60上是川崎双泵 100。

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Curing” from “Epoxy”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. When you need the printed 35 m³/h trailer and not the LZ-60 table. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 60 shortens the vertical cell to 350 m and raises output to 35 m³/h and engine power to 144 kW. Taken from the printed row: No grid means you do not rename it. Keep this cell as published. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 60 prints 3300 kg and is a 90 kW grid pump at 40 m³/h.
body.zh: 本节保留《Epoxy》的标题“养护”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。柴油50是 30 m³/h、150 m / 450 m。柴油60把垂直格收到 350 m，把输送量提到 35 m³/h，发动机提到 144 kW。如果垂直管路需要更长的 450 m 列出，柴油50的距离行可能更接近，尽管输送量更低。两个限制都要发。按邢台表上的原文理解：柴油60规格表上没有。LZ-60 在自己的页面上印了 4 cm 及以下。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Applications” in “Epoxy”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132 at 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 350 m and 3500 kg for sites without stable grid power. Taken from the printed row: If the vertical run needs the longer 450 m listing, Diesel 50 may still be the closer distance row even though output is lower. Keep this cell as published. You open Diesel 60 or another diesel page. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Kawasaki double pump 100 on Diesel 60.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Epoxy》的“用途”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：它为建筑浇筑印了 75 kW、35 m³/h 和三行石子。同样是 35 m³/h，也不会把它变成柴油泵。没有电网时不要给它改名。去打开柴油60或其他柴油页。目录里已经写着：柴油60印 3500 kg。电动60印 3300 kg，是 90 kW、40 m³/h 的电网泵。

body.en: “Epoxy” breaks its subject at “Production”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: LZ-60 prints the same code string at 50 m³/h, 100 m conveying and 300 m height. Keep this cell as published. Send both constraints. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Paste the Diesel 60 URL if you want 35 m³/h rather than LZ-60’s 50 m³/h. Read it in the Xingtai table. Not on the Diesel 60 specification list. Headings already printed: Step up only when 35 m³/h is the cell you mean Electric low-pressure 60 is the grid machine at 35 m³/h
body.zh: 《Epoxy》在“生产”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。目录里已经写着：如果你要的是 35 m³/h 而不是 LZ-60 的 50 m³/h，请贴上柴油60的地址。已印出的标题：只有你指的就是 35 m³/h 时才上这一档 电动低压60是 35 m³/h 的电网机器

question.en: What is the hydraulic pump cell, once the outline says “History”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“沿革”时，液压泵格是什么？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: Kawasaki double pump 100 on Diesel 60.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：柴油60上是川崎双泵 100。

question.zh: 在“化学关系”这一节里，印了骨料吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. Not on the Diesel 60 specification list. LZ-60 prints 4 cm and below on its own page.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：柴油60规格表上没有。LZ-60 在自己的页面上印了 4 cm 及以下。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Curing” — Is 3500 kg the same as Electric 60?
question.zh: “养护”旁边仍要印着的是什么：3500 kg 和电动60一样吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Diesel 60 prints 3500 kg. Electric 60 prints 3300 kg and is a 90 kW grid pump at 40 m³/h.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。柴油60印 3500 kg。电动60印 3300 kg，是 90 kW、40 m³/h 的电网泵。
